notes.title: Patch Notes – v0.23
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes – v0.23[/h3]

[h1] Save System[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed offline save/load issues where progress could reset after quitting.
[*] Added automatic save backups (.bak files) before overwriting save data.
[*] Prevented crashes when loading corrupted or incomplete save files.
[*] Auto-saves on exit to ensure progress isn’t lost.
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed delayed achievements that only unlocked after restarting (rebirth, coin milestones, upgrades, etc.).
[*] Added live triggers for all achievement types:
[*] Taps
[*] Coins earned (active & passive income)
[*] Upgrades purchased
[*] Tradies hired
[*] ebirth milestones
[*] Site unlocks
[*] Sausage sandwich clicked
[*] Buffs used and stacked (multi-buff support)
[*] Promo code claimed buffs
[*] Fixed achievement unlocks failing if SaveGameManager.CurrentSave wasn’t ready.
[*] Added null protection for achievement toast popups to prevent rare UI crashes.
[*] RetroactiveUnlock now checks:
[*] Total coins earned
[*] Taps
[*] Upgrades
[*] Tradies
[*] Rebirth milestones
[*] Buffs owned (for promo code claim)
[*] Sausage clicks (if tracked)
[/list]

[h1]Buff System[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multi-buff stacking enabled — players can now activate multiple buffs simultaneously.
[*] Fixed buff effects not applying properly when multiple buffs were active.
[*] Buff timers now run independently, and ending one buff no longer cancels others.
[*] Added Active Buffs overlay showing all active buffs with remaining timers.
[*] Improved buff multiplier logic to avoid stacking/expiration conflicts.
[/list]

[h1]Other Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Sausage Sandwich achievements not triggering.
[*] Added tracking for total sausage clicks (used for RetroactiveUnlock).
[*] Fixed Passive Income achievements not triggering from idle coin generation.
[/list]

[h1]Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] This patch applies to both offline and leaderboard game modes.
[*] Yes, you can now truly become a Sausage Power Legend.
[/list]

I've only done a quick test so any issues please tag me asap!

notes.title: Tradie Tapper Patch Notes v0.22
notes.content:
[h1][b][u]Tradie Tapper Patch Notes v0.22 – Buffs, Panels, and Anti-Cheat Update[/u][/b]
[/h1][p]Hey everyone

First off, sorry for the delay on this patch. Between some stubborn issues (Steam achievements were being a headache) and long IRL work days, it took a bit longer than planned. Thanks for hanging in there :heart:[/p][p]Here’s everything packed into today’s update:[/p][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][h3][b][u]Hover Panels
[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added hover panels for Buff Inventory and Shop Items.[/p][/*][*][p]Displays Name, Description, Cost, and Duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Smart positioning above or to the left of the mouse with screen edge clamping.[/p][/*][*][p]Matches UI theme for a polished look.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Retroactive Achievement Unlocks
[/h3][list][*][p]Any missed Steam achievements now auto-unlock the next time your save loads.[/p][/*][*][p]Covers milestones like total taps, coins, tradies hired, and rebirths.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Anti-Cheat Enhancements
[/h3][list][*][p]Added MemoryScannerDetector to block tools like Cheat Engine and debuggers.[/p][/*][*][p]Alerts players with a native Windows popup and exits the game if detected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fully safe on Mac and Mobile (code wrapped with platform checks).
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Equipment Panel ghost clicks by switching to CanvasGroup alpha toggling.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed buffs not reusable after cooldowns. They now refresh properly and no restart is required.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hover tooltips rendering behind skill icons. Tooltips now stay visible above all UI elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam achievements not unlocking due to outdated API calls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hover panel position. Panels now follow the mouse cursor and stay within screen bounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Save Game button showing in leaderboard mode.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]UI Improvements
[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Redesigned panel toggles using AlphaToggle(GameObject panel) for smoother transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Buff Inventory now includes a clean header panel and a dark backdrop for better contrast.[/p][/*][*][p]Hover panels now feel like proper tooltips with live tracking and consistent theme styling.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Leaderboard Cheater Handling
[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Blocked flagged accounts from updating or accessing leaderboard data.[/p][/*][*][p]Added backend validation plans to protect legit players without overreach.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Quality of Life
[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Buff buttons now enable/disable properly after cooldown ends.[/p][/*][*][p]Hover tooltips automatically adjust for canvas scale and different resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Periodic refresh added to BuffManager so UI stays up to date every 5 seconds.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Performance & Stability
[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Wrapped Process.GetProcesses() calls in try/catch to avoid Unity crashes when scanning system processes.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up SteamManager and AchievementManager for modern API compatibility.[/p][/*][*][p]This patch also includes backend anti-cheat improvements and general polish to keep things smooth as we prepare for future updates.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Next up[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]More tradie upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Three new units in the works[/p][/*][*][p]Multi-lingual translation[/p][/*][*][p]Mobile launch prep (PC and mobile will have separate leaderboards)
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for your patience and support[/p]
